scope: One existing-entity herd behavior from cached adult visibility ratio to attack or retreat before outgoing damage, with distinct incoming retaliation and expiry.
chain: Nearest living sensor assembles a distance-ordered list of live other actors. The targetability wrapper caches results. HoglinSpecificSensor reads the cached visible lists and counts only nonbaby Hoglin and Piglin class instances. Piglin Brute is outside the counted Piglin class. It is a periodic cached census, not a fresh count at the decision.

Hoglin.doHurtTarget calls the herd logic before HoglinBase requests actual target damage. The adult retreat branch requires exact PIGLIN target type and cached adult Piglins strictly greater than cached other adult Hoglins plus one. Otherwise adults send attack. Babies skip outgoing herd dispatch.

Cached adult recipients choose the closest remembered or incoming threat, clear attack and walk targets and receive an avoidance memory with sampled duration 100–400 ticks. Adults can erase it early when their own counts no longer show a majority, with no baby early-clear branch. Attack broadcast skips pacified peers and uses a 200 tick attack memory.

A separate incoming post-super.hurt branch requires a successful result and actual living causer. It clears pacification and breeding memories, with baby retreat and additional adult retaliation guards. The biome-independent repellent block tag is an IDLE/FIGHT pacification input, not a required input to the ratio decision.

accepted.difference: Alarm latch triggers creation. Hoglin acts on existing entities using an interspecies count.
Food-driven howl and timeout differs from cached ratios and per-recipient nearest target choice.
Calendar/finite siege waves differ from live herd movement decision before a damage result.
Zombie reinforcement after accepted incoming damage does not implement the before-outgoing-damage herd decision.
Shared warning gating a new encounter does not implement a relative adult count or response reversal.
Piglin barter and admiration are separate material policy; reciprocal Piglin count remains support for the same herd family.

independent_review.verbatim:
**Independent verdict: one distinct source-only candidate.** The mechanism is an adult Hoglin using cached local numbers to choose between retreat and attack, then updating nearby herd members’ targets. The relevant legacy rows cover conversion, barter, and generic memory expiry. I found no accepted owner for this herd decision.

- **Outgoing attack order.** `Hoglin.java:78–87` starts the animation, broadcasts the event, and plays the attack sound before calling `HoglinAi.onHitTarget`. Only then does `HoglinBase.java:12–29` call the victim’s `hurt`. Herd memories can therefore change even if damage fails. On an exact `PIGLIN` target, an adult Hoglin retreats if cached adult Piglins **strictly outnumber** cached other adult Hoglins plus the actor. Otherwise it broadcasts attack. Babies skip this outgoing herd decision (`HoglinAi.java:100–128,143–150`). [Attack caller](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/tools/cod4/legacy-migration-acceptance/.work/sources/minecraft-forge-1.20.1-47.4.10/net/minecraft/world/entity/monster/hoglin/Hoglin.java:78)
- **Counts, broadcast, and expiry.** `HoglinSpecificSensor.java:23–49` caches visible adults from the nearest-living sensor’s list, which excludes the actor. Piglin Brutes are outside the `instanceof Piglin` count. These are periodic snapshots, so the attack makes no fresh census. Retreat recipients choose the nearest of the incoming threat and their remembered avoid and attack targets, clear attack and walk memories, and sample an avoid expiry of **100–400 ticks**. During AVOID, adults can clear the memory early when their own cached counts cease to show a Piglin majority. Babies cannot take that early-clear branch. Attack broadcasts skip pacified recipients and set or refresh a nearer attack target for **200 ticks** (`HoglinAi.java:43,80–81,111–150,177–195,216–218`). [Sensor](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/tools/cod4/legacy-migration-acceptance/.work/sources/minecraft-forge-1.20.1-47.4.10/net/minecraft/world/entity/ai/sensing/HoglinSpecificSensor.java:23) · [Herd decisions](/Users/a15356015027/Desktop/dynasty/tools/cod4/legacy-migration-acceptance/.work/sources/minecraft-forge-1.20.1-47.4.10/net/minecraft/world/entity/monster/hoglin/HoglinAi.java:100)
- **Incoming retaliation and repellents.** `Hoglin.java:97–107` calls `wasHurtBy` server-side only after `super.hurt` returns true with a living causer. It clears pacification and breeding memory. Babies retreat. Adults skip a Piglin causer while AVOID is active, skip Hoglin causers, and otherwise check distance and attackability before retaliating and broadcasting (`HoglinAi.java:153–195`). Repellent sensing searches **8 horizontal and 4 vertical**. IDLE and FIGHT can use the cached repellent to pacify for 200 ticks and clear the attack target. Repellent presence is not a prerequisite for the outnumbered retreat branch.
